Elephant’s Air Power Lab

PLAY · WIND AND MOVING THINGS

Elephant’s Air Power Lab

The wind is blowing! Tap all the things that can move when the wind blows. Heavy things stay put!

Tap everything the wind can move!

0 of 3 found

Wind power found!

The pinwheel spins, the kite soars, and the feather floats away. The rock, brick and anvil stay right where they are!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Wind moves light things — the start of weather science. Test it: blow a feather across the table, then try a brick! Ask what makes a kite stay UP.
